messages.content: I am a privacy-minded home user. I want a private AI setup on my own machine but I do not want to assemble it myself. What would I get?

response.reply: We can set up a private AI on your own machine for you.  It’s a good fit for privacy‑minded home users who want a private AI but don’t want to assemble the stack themselves.  We’ll install and configure the system on your hardware, hand you a concise hand‑off document, and give you a short follow‑up to make sure everything’s running smoothly.  If you’d like ongoing support, we offer an optional monthly check‑in retainer.  The first 30‑minute consultation is free and will let us scope your exact needs and machine details.  Feel free to book that call through our website or by email.
